author: BrooksBeast27
body:
The fortress is only good for late game upgrading to masterforged, and for the extra dungeon. You can masterforge at a lower level, but its really only worth it after t9 and with how little you'd be doing it now, finding one at town or joining a party with access to one if better then wasting 1m orns for a convenient MF. The extra dungeon can be tempting, but same as the MF its just better to save your orns and use the dungeons already established on the overworld. Now when you hit that big ol' wall at t9 then definitely get the fortress asap you'll be needing all the hard boss runs you can get. 

To go off of the OP's question, how about Castle? Is 10m really worth it anytime before T10?
